story_text:
## Time to go bigger with Large Scale 3D Printing
"What if sharing and printing massive 3D models was as simple as sending a single link?"
For years, creating large 3D projects meant fighting the physical limits of standard build plates.
If a model was too big, designers had to spend hours manually slicing geometry in complex CAD programs, while makers were left dealing with fragmented STL files, clunky software downloads, and guesswork assembly.
We set out to eliminate that entire barrier and gave it away for free.
Right now everyone can head over to segmentkit.com and use it free of charge o without downloading any additional software.
Instead of getting the model from one place, upload it or import it into another software, what if you could do it in one swift workflow while preserving the setting the buyer recommends for easy printing with repeatable results.
By building Segment Marketplace as a web-first, browser-based ecosystem, we’re transforming large scale additive manufacturing from an isolated, technical chore into a seamless, shared community experience.
## How Segment Marketplace Works: 3 Simple Steps
You don’t need CAD experience, expensive software downloads, or technical slicing skills. As long as a model is watertight and clean, Segment Marketplace handles the entire breakdown automatically in your browser:
Step 1- For Designers, just Upload the full model: You can upload your model and segment it for yourself before offering it to customers. Models can also be offered with "recommended" settings from the original creator of the model.
Step 2- Share your project with a single link to anyone across the world ready to be segmented.
For 3D printing enthusiasts find & purchase: Discover ambitious, large scale original designs from life sized cosplay armor and automotive parts to furniture and architectural models.
Select & Segment: Choose your specific printer build volume. Segment Marketplace automatically divides the model, places self aligning joints, and applies assembly coordinates.
Customers can select a segment by printer size or manually adjust each cutting plane.
Download & Print: Export your optimized files and drag them straight into your favorite slicer (OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, Cura).
Each Piece is properly labeled for easy assembly.
## Each Piece is has it's part number engraved and you can also add connectors to assemble it like "Legos"
## Why the web-first approach?
## The Power of sharing Big Ideas with a Small Link
Traditional file distribution forces users to download massive archives, install heavy desktop software, and figure out how to cut parts themselves.
Segment Marketplace changes the game:
Instant Link Sharing: Designers can share an ambitious, life-size creation using a single URL. Anyone who opens the link can preview, inspect, and interact with the full-scale model directly in their browser, no downloads, plugins, or CAD software required.
On-Demand Client-Side Slicing: When a maker clicks your link, our browser engine automatically adapts the model to their specific printer size, generating custom interlocking joints, clearance tolerances, and printable sections in real time.
Zero Software Friction: Whether you’re on a desktop PC, a laptop, or a tablet, you can inspect, segment, and prepare multi-part builds in minutes without paying for or downloading extra slicing software.
## Real World Use
This isn’t just a concept on a whiteboard, it’s technology already building real-world projects today.
We didn't launch this Kickstarter with just an idea and a pitch deck. Before building Segment Marketplace, we developed SegmentKit, our working, web-based engine to prove that automated, intelligent model segmentation works in the hands of real makers.
We didn't build this tool for tiny trinkets or desk toys. Segment was created specifically for the high impact, ambitious projects that standard build plates usually kill before they start:
## If you're going big, why do it alone?
We developed this project along side our community members with real world feedback.
For example one of our members used a humble ender3 3D Printer to create massive car parts.
"Segment is what allowed me to build my wildest dreams and I can't wait to see it do the same for others"
Jose Pereira- Community Member
You too can get access to our community with member like Jose to help you develop your project.
## Built for Community & Creator Collaboration
## Other marketplaces are stuck in the past forcing users to download compressed files, unzip, read the instructions then figure it out by themselves.
Large-scale printing shouldn't be a solo headache; it should be a shared journey. Segment Marketplace is designed around community-driven features that make building ambitious projects collaborative and fun:
Interactive Assembly Guides & Exploded Views: Every shared model comes with an automatically generated, 3D exploded view. Creators and makers can share step-by-step assembly guides with embedded part numbers, taking the confusion out of multi-piece builds.
Community Print Logs & Fit Validation: Makers can upload photos of their completed builds, rate joint tolerances, and share printer-specific profiles directly on the model’s page, helping others choose the best settings for their exact machine.
Remixable Joint Configurations: Want tighter press-fits for a mechanical assembly or looser tolerances for a painted cosplay prop? Community members can save and share custom joint configurations for specific materials (like PLA vs. PETG vs. ABS).
Protecting Designers, Empowering Makers: Because slicing happens through our cloud engine, creators can share and monetize their largest, most complex original geometry while keeping the source files protected. Makers get full customization flexibility without risking file piracy for the designer.
## From Single Printers to Print Farm Scale
A web-first approach doesn't just make sharing easy, it turns everyday printer setups into high-speed production engines:
Parallel Manufacturing: Split a massive 120-hour print job across 10 standard desktop machines with a few clicks, finishing the entire assembly in a single afternoon.
Fail-Safe Printing: If one section fails during a 10-hour print, you don't waste an entire roll of filament. Simply re-print that single segment directly from your browser dashboard.
Auto-Engraved Coordinate Tracking: Every piece generated by our web engine is stamped with subtle markings, turning complex 100-piece projects into intuitive, self-guiding puzzles with the visual 3D aid.
## White-Label for Pro Sellers
## Make Segment Your Own.
Elevate your brand and deliver an end-to-end large-scale 3D printing solution directly on your website. With our White-Label program, Pro Sellers can integrate the Segment engine as their own proprietary tool, no heavy development required.
Your Brand Front & Center: Seamlessly feature your business logo, custom brand colors, and domain. Your customers experience a polished, professional solution that belongs entirely to you.
Share Anywhere: Drop the interactive Segment engine directly into your existing domain, customer portal, or website to give buyers real-time, browser-based model customization and segmentation.
Instant, Frictionless Slicing: Let customers auto-segment large designs, add interlocking connectors, and prepare builds for their specific printer dimensions, all without ever leaving your brand’s ecosystem or downloading external software.
Complete Authority: Turn complex geometric preparation into a white-labeled value add that increases sales conversion, builds brand authority, and keeps customers coming back to your store.
The white label is only available to use with your existing model gatalog. To upload new designs you can use segmentkit.
## Democratizing the Future of Additive Manufacturing
Whether you're building full-scale automotive prototypes, life-sized cosplay armor, custom furniture, or industrial enclosures, you no longer need a $10,000 industrial machine to build big.
Segment Marketplace bridges the gap between ambitious designers and passionate makers. One link. Unlimited scale. Built by the community, for the community.
Full-Scale Automotive & Engineering Prototypes: From full 1:1 scale vehicle bumpers and body panels to custom intake ducting and functional jigs. Instead of tying up a $20,000 industrial printer for a week, makers are splitting 200cm+ assemblies into modular prints across a fleet of standard $300 desktop machines, finishing builds in hours instead of days.
1:1 Life-Size Props & Cosplay Armor: Creators are taking massive, highly detailed 3D models full-body armor suits, oversized replica gear, and giant display sculptures, and converting them into self-aligning, multi-piece build kits. No manual cutting in CAD, no guesswork, and zero software downloads required.
Functional Architectural & Industrial Models: Architectural firms and product engineers are printing massive, multi-part structural models and protective industrial enclosures with built-in alignment pins that snap together with press-fit precision right off the build plate.
## From Monolithic Failures to Parallel Production
Before Segment, printing a massive model was a high risk gamble. A single print failure 40 hours into a giant build meant a ruined spool of filament, a clogged nozzle, and days of lost time.
With Segment's automated joint placement and coordinate tracking (part marking), those same ambitious projects become intelligent, fail safe puzzles. If one segment fails, you reprint that single piece in an hour, not the entire 5kg build.
Hundreds of makers are already using the free engine today to bring impossible designs to life. We’ve built the engine. Now, with your support, we’re building the marketplace to connect visionary designers with the makers who want to build bigger.
So we hope we can count on your help.
Thank you
Segment Team
risks: 1⃣ Core Engine & Marketplace Development TimelineRisk: Expanding our existing engine (SegmentKit) into a full-scale commercial marketplace with automated cut-plane placement, embedded joint generation, and user store fronts can present unexpected software delays.Mitigation: We are not starting from scratch. Our core browser engine, SegmentKit is already functional and live, capable of splitting geometry, adding alignment pins, and rendering 3D models directly in WebGL. Our primary remaining tasks focus on marketplace infrastructure: creator dashboards, seamless 3MF/STL export optimization, and community print logs. By building on an established codebase, we have scheduled a realistic development roadmap with built-in buffer periods to ensure on-time delivery without compromising stability. 2⃣ Cross-Browser & Multi-Device CompatibilityRisk: Delivering heavy 3D geometry manipulation, auto-engraving part numbers, and client-side web slicing across diverse browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and varying hardware specs can lead to performance bottlenecks or rendering inconsistencies.Mitigation: Segment Marketplace is engineered web-first using lightweight WebGL and web-assembly principles that process geometry smoothly on everyday desktop, laptop, and tablet hardware. We prioritize cross-browser web standards over OS-native builds. Development milestones begin with optimization for major desktop browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari), followed by expanded mobile browser scaling based on beta feedback. 3⃣ Cloud Slicing & File Security (DRM)Risk: Storing, displaying, and segmenting complex 3D files inside a web browser opens potential risks of digital piracy or unauthorized geometry scraping of creators' high-value assets.Mitigation: Segment Marketplace protects creator intellectual property by running segmentation algorithms through our cloud pipeline. End-users interact with optimized render assets in their browser without ever having direct access to raw source geometry until a legitimate purchase or export occurs. We perform continuous security audits and maintain dedicated technical support to address platform permissions or access issues immediately. 4⃣ Market Adoption & Creator OnboardingRisk: Convincing 3D designers and makers to shift from legacy desktop slicing tools (like traditional CAD utilities or manual cutting in slicers) to a web-first marketplace requires breaking long-standing habits.Mitigation: We are solving real, tangible pain points: eliminating multi-gigabyte downloads, manual CAD slicing, and high print-failure risks on large-scale models. We are actively partnering with 3D printing influencers, cosplayers, automotive fabricators, and print-farm operators during our beta phase. By demonstrating real-world builds (such as life-sized armor and functional 1:1 auto parts built on standard desktop printers), we leverage direct community social proof to drive organic platform growth. 5⃣ Post-Launch Infrastructure & Long-Term Marketplace…

faq.a: Segment Marketplace is a web-first platform designed specifically for large-scale 3D printing. It connects designers with makers by allowing creators to upload massive models once, while buyers automatically adapt and segment those models to fit their exact printer build volume using our integrated, browser-based SegmentKit engine.

faq.q: What file formats are supported on Segment Marketplace?
faq.a: Segment Marketplace supports STL and 3MF, and high-density 3D meshes. Because our cloud engine processes files on demand, creators can upload detailed models without requiring buyers to download massive raw archives. Additional native file format integrations are planned on our software expansion roadmap.

faq.q: Does Segment Marketplace replace my slicer?
faq.a: No. Segment Marketplace acts as the intelligent breakdown architect before slicing. It divides your oversized model, generates self-aligning joints, and engraves assembly coordinates onto each part. Once segmented, you download the optimized pieces and drag them straight into your preferred slicer (OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, Cura, etc.) to set print profiles and send them to your printer.

Because Segment Marketplace and SegmentKit are web-first platforms, they run directly inside your web browser. This means native compatibility across:
Windows (10 & 11)
macOS
Linux
ChromeOS & Mobile Browsers (for model viewing and inspecting)
No software installation, drivers, or heavy GPU software downloads are required.

faq.q: Is there a standalone offline version or desktop tool?
faq.a: While the core Segment engine runs seamlessly in the browser for cloud sharing and instant segmentation, our creator ecosystem includes web-connected workflows and local processing tools to ensure privacy and offline file handling for power users. We are planning on adding local tools for off-line processing

faq.q: How do seller accounts, licenses, and transaction fees work?
faq.a:
For Buyers/Makers: Accessing the platform, browsing, and segmenting purchased designs to fit your specific printer build volume is free with model purchases.

For Creators/Sellers: Kickstarter backers can secure lifetime benefits, including 0% platform transaction fees and early Pro Seller verification badges. Post-campaign seller tiers will operate on standard platform fee structures or monthly pro memberships.

faq.q: Will there be organization or team options for print farms and schools?
faq.a: Yes! Our top Kickstarter stretch goal unlocks Team & Print Farm Licenses, allowing multiple workstations, print farm operators, or educational institutions to manage shared model libraries, custom printer profiles, and multi-user segmentation workflows.

faq.q: Will there be a free trial version?
faq.a: Yes! You can test our core engine technology today via SegmentKit.com for free to see how automated model splitting, tenon placement, and joint tolerances work before purchasing models or seller tiers.

faq.q: What about platform updates after launch?
faq.a: Yes! All Kickstarter backers receive lifetime access to platform upgrades unlocked during the campaign, including new joint styles, auto-labeling improvements, and enhanced clearance adjustment options.

faq.q: Where does the name "Segment" come from?
faq.a: "Segment" represents breaking past traditional build boundaries. Dividing massive, ambitious designs into intelligent, printable sections so your physical printer size never limits your imagination again.

faq.q: How is segment different from solutions like LuBan?
faq.a:
While legacy tools like LuBan offer standalone desktop splitting with complex menus, Segment Marketplace transforms the entire workflow into a seamless, browser-based ecosystem:

Zero-Friction Web Architecture: No downloads, no software installations, and no CAD experience required. Everything runs instantly inside your web browser.

Effortless Single-Link Sharing: Share massive, multi-part designs using a simple URL that anyone can open, inspect, and interact with on any device.
